data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'J-L-S', meaning 'to settle, calm down'. In Islamic tradition, the name symbolizes a tranquil and peaceful soul. The name Jalsaan carries the meaning “Gentle, Calm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jalsaan usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, calm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
